Python.tip: Finish a beginner Python course, then build one small script that reads a file and prints a summary.

Java.tip: Learn classes, collections and exceptions, then build a small console app such as a library manager.

JavaScript.tip: Learn variables, functions, arrays and DOM basics, then make a to-do list page.

TypeScript.tip: Convert a small JavaScript project to TypeScript to learn types.

C++.tip: Practice pointers, STL containers and 20 easy problems on any coding site.

C#.tip: Follow Microsoft's free C# intro and build a small console app.

Go.tip: Do the official Tour of Go, then write a tiny HTTP server.

SQL.tip: Practice SELECT, JOIN and GROUP BY on a sample database until they feel easy.

MySQL.tip: Install MySQL locally and design a two-table database with a join.

PostgreSQL.tip: Install PostgreSQL and repeat your SQL practice there.

MongoDB.tip: Store and query documents in a free MongoDB Atlas cluster.

HTML.tip: Build a plain multi-section page by hand using semantic tags.

CSS.tip: Rebuild a website layout you like using flexbox and grid.

React.tip: Learn components, props and state, then build a small app with a list and a form.

Node.js.tip: Build a small REST server with Node and Express.

Flask.tip: Follow the Flask quickstart and build one API with two routes.

Django.tip: Do the official Django tutorial (the polls app).

FastAPI.tip: Follow the FastAPI tutorial and build a CRUD API.

REST APIs.tip: Learn HTTP methods and status codes, then build and test an API with Postman.

UI/UX.tip: Redesign one app screen and explain your choices in a short write-up.

Figma.tip: Make a 3-screen clickable prototype in Figma's free plan.

Machine Learning.tip: Take a machine learning basics course and train a model on a public dataset.

Deep Learning.tip: Build an image or text classifier with a neural network from a tutorial.

NLP.tip: Build a text classifier: clean text, vectorise it, train a model.

Computer Vision.tip: Detect faces or objects in images using OpenCV.

TensorFlow.tip: Train an MNIST digit classifier with Keras.

PyTorch.tip: Follow PyTorch's 60-minute blitz and train a small network.

scikit-learn.tip: Train, test and compare three models on one dataset.

Pandas.tip: Clean a messy CSV using Pandas: filter, group and merge.

NumPy.tip: Practice array maths and indexing with 10 small exercises.

Statistics.tip: Revise mean, variance, distributions and hypothesis testing.

Data Visualization.tip: Make five different charts from one dataset and write what each shows.

Power BI.tip: Build one dashboard from a public dataset in Power BI Desktop.

Tableau.tip: Build one dashboard in Tableau Public.

Excel.tip: Learn lookups, pivot tables and charts on a real dataset.

Data Structures.tip: Solve 2 easy problems a day on arrays, strings, hash maps and trees.

OOP.tip: Model a small system (for example a bank) using classes and inheritance.

Operating Systems.tip: Revise processes, threads, scheduling and memory management.

Git.tip: Learn branch, commit, merge and pull request, and push a project to GitHub.

Docker.tip: Write a Dockerfile for one of your projects and run it.

Kubernetes.tip: Learn pods and deployments using a local cluster like minikube.

Linux.tip: Practise the command line: files, permissions, grep and a small bash script.

AWS.tip: Deploy a small app on the AWS free tier (EC2 or S3).

Azure.tip: Deploy a small web app on Azure's free tier.

GCP.tip: Deploy a small app on Google Cloud Run's free tier.

CI/CD.tip: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs your tests on every push.

Testing.tip: Write unit tests for one of your projects and aim for the main paths.

Agile.tip: Read the Scrum Guide (13 pages) and run a one-week sprint on your own project.

Communication.tip: Write a one-page explanation of a project and present it to a friend.

Teamwork.tip: Join a group project or hackathon and note your specific contribution.

Problem Solving.tip: Keep a log of problems you solved, with steps and outcome, for interviews.
